v_agg:
SELECT count(*) AS total,
    count(status) AS c2,
    max(username) AS mx,
    sum(1) AS s
   FROM users u;
v_cte:
WITH active AS (
         SELECT users.username,
            users.status
           FROM users
          WHERE (users.status = 'ONLINE'::user_status)
        )
 SELECT username,
    status
   FROM active a;
v_case:
SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN (status IS NULL) THEN 'x'::text
            ELSE 'y'::text
        END AS c,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM messages) AS s,
    (username || 'x'::text) AS concat
   FROM users u;
v_cast:
SELECT (username)::character varying(10) AS a,
    (1)::bigint AS b,
    NULL::text AS c,
    (status)::text AS d,
    (data)::text AS e,
    'ONLINE'::user_status AS f
   FROM users u;
v_full:
SELECT u.username,
    p.id AS pid
   FROM (users u
     FULL JOIN user_profiles p ON ((p.username = u.username)));
v_left:
SELECT u.username,
    p.id AS pid,
    p.username AS puser
   FROM (users u
     LEFT JOIN user_profiles p ON ((p.username = u.username)));
v_over:
SELECT username,
    count(*) OVER () AS c,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY username) AS rn
   FROM users u;
v_star:
SELECT id,
    data,
    message,
    username,
    channel_id
   FROM messages;
v_subq:
SELECT username,
    n
   FROM ( SELECT u.username,
            count(*) AS n
           FROM users u
          GROUP BY u.username) s;
v_const:
SELECT 1 AS a,
    'x'::text AS b,
    true AS c,
    false AS d,
    NULL::integer AS e,
    1.5 AS f,
    now() AS g;
v_cross:
SELECT u.username,
    c.slug
   FROM (users u
     CROSS JOIN channels c);
v_group:
SELECT status,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM users u
  GROUP BY status;
v_inner:
SELECT u.username,
    p.id AS pid,
    p.username AS puser
   FROM (users u
     JOIN user_profiles p ON ((p.username = u.username)));
v_multi:
SELECT u.username,
    m.id AS mid,
    c.slug
   FROM ((users u
     LEFT JOIN messages m ON ((m.username = u.username)))
     JOIN channels c ON ((c.id = m.channel_id)));
v_plain:
SELECT username,
    status,
    data
   FROM users u;
v_right:
SELECT u.username,
    p.id AS pid
   FROM (users u
     RIGHT JOIN user_profiles p ON ((p.username = u.username)));
v_using:
SELECT u.username,
    u.status,
    p.id
   FROM (users u
     JOIN user_profiles p USING (username));
f_params: select p, m.username, m.id from public.messages m where m.username = p
v_except:
SELECT users.username AS n
   FROM users
EXCEPT
 SELECT user_profiles.username AS n
   FROM user_profiles;
v_rollup:
SELECT username,
    status,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM users u
  GROUP BY ROLLUP(username, status);
v_union2:
SELECT users.username AS n
   FROM users
UNION
 SELECT user_profiles.username AS n
   FROM user_profiles;
v_lateral:
SELECT u.username,
    l.id
   FROM (users u
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.id
           FROM messages m
          WHERE (m.username = u.username)
         LIMIT 1) l ON (true));
v_coalesce:
SELECT COALESCE(age_range, '[0,1)'::int4range) AS a,
    COALESCE(status, 'ONLINE'::user_status) AS b,
    COALESCE(data, data) AS c,
    COALESCE(username, 'x'::text) AS d
   FROM users u;
v_distinct:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (username) username,
    status
   FROM users u
  ORDER BY username
 LIMIT 5;
v_intersect:
SELECT users.username AS n
   FROM users
INTERSECT
 SELECT user_profiles.username AS n
   FROM user_profiles;
